title: Copilot Notebooks: audio overview gains topic episodes, Critique and Debate formats and label support
summary: Hold: Microsoft documents preview Graph automation for the Notebooks creation policy, contrary to the table's automation gap. The briefing also incorrectly calls Cloud Policy the only control reaching Notebooks and overlooks published protection rules for labelled source data; its roadmap facts and admin navigation are supported.

claims.claim: The Cloud Policy setting controls creation and integration of Copilot Notebooks as a whole, and applies to Copilot Pages too.

claims.claim: Cloud Policy can apply the Notebooks setting to all tenant users or a selected group.

claims.claim: No API or automation is documented for the Copilot Pages and Copilot Notebooks creation control.
claims.quote: Allows or prevents creating and viewing Copilot Pages and Copilot Notebooks ... 0 disables the setting; 1 enables the setting.
claims.fix: Set controls[0].api to kind 'graph', call 'POST /beta/admin/configurationManagement/configurationMonitors', docs 'https://learn.microsoft.com/graph/api/configurationmanagement-post-configurationmonitors?view=graph-rest-beta'. Add to the note: 'Preview TCM automation uses mode applyOnce and baseline.resources with resourceType microsoft.copilot.copilotpagesnotebooks, resourceVersion 1 and properties.value set to the string 0 (disable) or 1 (enable). TCM supports tenant-level policies only and fails if this setting is configured in a group-level policy. The signed-in user requires AI Administrator; the calling app requires delegated ConfigurationMonitoring.ReadWrite.All and the TCM service principal requires delegated CopilotPolicySettings.ReadWrite.' Cite https://learn.microsoft.com/graph/utcm-copilot-resources alongside the endpoint reference.

claims.where: Why it matters; Risk assessment: Data exposure
claims.claim: Microsoft has not documented how a sensitivity label on a source file affects its treatment in an audio summary.
claims.quote: If the labels apply encryption from Microsoft Purview Information Protection, Copilot and agents check the usage rights for the user. Then, Copilot and agents return data from an item only if the user is granted permissions to copy (the EXTRACT usage right) from that item.
claims.fix: Replace the source-file-treatment absence in Why it matters and Risk assessment with: 'Microsoft documents that Copilot checks users' usage rights for source items encrypted by sensitivity labels and returns their data only when the user has the EXTRACT right. Audio overview output label inheritance for these updates is not yet documented.' Cite https://learn.microsoft.com/purview/sensitivity-labels. Keep the narrower question about labels on the generated audio, rather than implying that no source-protection rule is known.

claims.claim: Learn's compliance summary says no end-user recycle bin exists for Copilot Notebooks.
claims.quote: Recycle bin: No end-user recycle bin exists. Limitation: Neither administrators nor end users can recover individually deleted Copilot Notebooks.
claims.fix: Replace the recycle-bin bullet's factual premise with: 'Learn's compliance summary says no end-user recycle bin exists, but its storage page says deleted Pages and Notebooks stored in OneDrive can be found in the OneDrive recycle bin; the storage page distinguishes legacy items created before November 2025.' Cite https://learn.microsoft.com/microsoft-365/loop/cpcn-storage and retain the support-staff advice.

claims.claim: Learn says Notebook storage counts toward the organisation's overall SharePoint quota.
claims.quote: Storage counts toward your organization's overall SharePoint quota.
claims.fix: Replace the storage-cost sentence with: 'The admin policies page says storage counts toward the organisation's SharePoint quota, while the storage page says current Pages and Notebooks count against the user's OneDrive storage limit and reserves the SharePoint-quota statement for legacy items created before November 2025.' Cite https://learn.microsoft.com/microsoft-365/loop/cpcn-storage.

claims.claim: Learn's compliance summary says Copilot Notebooks are stored in a user-owned SharePoint Embedded container shared with Copilot Pages and Loop My workspace.
claims.quote: Copilot Pages and Copilot Notebooks are stored together in a single user-owned SharePoint Embedded container, which is also shared by Loop My workspace.
claims.fix: Replace the storage-location clause with: 'Learn's compliance summary says Notebooks share a user-owned SharePoint Embedded container with Copilot Pages and Loop My workspace, but the storage page says current Pages and Notebooks are stored in OneDrive for Business; items created before November 2025 remain in the legacy container.' Cite https://learn.microsoft.com/microsoft-365/loop/cpcn-storage.
